The M+1 intensity (~8 %) points to about 7 carbons, and the very low M+2 intensity indicates no halogens. A plausible formula is C₇H₁₀O₂ (exact neutral mass 126.0681 Da, [M+H]⁺ 127.0754 Da, close to the observed value). I will obtain the ¹H NMR spectrum to narrow down the structural possibilities for C₇H₁₀O₂.</thought>
